description: BuNo 162916 falls in the final 162910-162926 Tomcat block delivered as F-14A+/F-14B so the variant is consistent; Aerial Visuals gives the full designation as F-14B-145-GR; displayed on the post lawn on East Locust Street; present in OpenStreetMap 28 July 2026 as way 1420748592 named F-14B Tomcat beside node 7326924035 for the post itself; note the post name is rendered Richard R. Gross by Aerial Visuals and Richard J. Gross by OSM. Presence confirmed in current aerial imagery.
museum_name: VFW Post 8896 Richard J. Gross Post -- East Berlin
